champion.tips: MORGANA TIPS AND TRICKS Get as close to the target as you can when ganking to make it easier for you to land your Q . If you miss your Q , the gank has basically failed. Morgana is great at picking off targets. Don’t be afraid to throw your Binding Q from fog of war on an unexpected target. Give your Blackshield E to targets that are going to get blown up by incoming damage or locked down from hard CC.
champion.builds: THE BEST MORGANA BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR JUNGLE IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Morgana Jungle build, you should take Flash and Smite as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Dark Harvest as your keystone, followed by Cheap Shot, Grisly Mementos and Treasure Hunter in the primary tree, as well as Magical Footwear and Cosmic Insight in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Adaptive Force in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Blackfire Torch as your first item, followed by Sorcerer's Shoes and Liandry's Torment. For your last 3 items, you should build Zhonya's Hourglass, Rabadon's Deathcap and finish with Banshee's Veil. For the skill order, you want to stick with W - Q - E. Right now, this build has 53.7% winrate over 741 matches played. Optional Your second option for Morgana Jungle build would be to take Flash and Smite as your Summoner Spells. The runes that this build takes advantage of are Dark Harvest as your keystone, Cheap Shot, Grisly Mementos and Treasure Hunter in the primary tree, and Magical Footwear with Cosmic Insight in the secondary tree. The shards used in this build are Adaptive Force in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense. The items for the build are Liandry's Torment, which you should build first, followed by Sorcerer's Shoes as your second item and Zhonya's Hourglass as your third item. The rest of the items in order are Horizon Focus, Rabadon's Deathcap and Morellonomicon. The skill order for this build is W - Q - E. In the current patch, this build has a 52.2% win rate over 645 matches. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Flash and Smite as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Arcane Comet as your keystone, Manaflow Band, Transcendence and Scorch in the primary tree, and Cheap Shot with Ultimate Hunter in the secondary tree, as well as Adaptive Force, Adaptive Force, and Health Scaling as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Liandry's Torment as your first item, then Sorcerer's Shoes as a second item and Zhonya's Hourglass as a third item. You want to finish the build with Horizon Focus, Rabadon's Deathcap and Shadowflame. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it W - Q - E. This build is currently sitting at a 54.3% win rate across 208 matches played. Situational Morgana Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Morgana build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Morgana runes page.
